pb-youtube-research.publicBoundary: Public statistics only. Private analytics need an owner export. Nothing is posted.
pb-youtube-research.demo: Demo: no provider access. Do not enter a real key.
pb-youtube-research.session: The key lasts only while this business is open. The typed input clears after submission or changing order.
pb-youtube-research.quota: Local attempts are tracked by your project and Pacific day. Other apps and workspaces also use quota. Google decides the available quota. Each page asks separately.
pb-youtube-research.publicSaved: Saved the actual response as an order source. Choose that file below for measured analysis.
pb-youtube-research.noRetry: No automatic retry. This attempt stays counted. Check the provider, then prepare a new request yourself.
pb-youtube-research.state.running: The read may be in progress. Closing it does not undo the counted attempt.
pb-youtube-research.error.REQUEST_FAILED: Could not complete this step. Review the current order and try again.
pb-youtube-research.error.YOUTUBE_KEY_RE: Connect your own key for this session.
pb-youtube-research.error.YOUTUBE_READ_F: The public source could not be read. No request was retried.
pb-youtube-research.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The request changed. Review the exact current version.
pb-youtube-research.error.DERIVED_STALE: The order or source changed. Prepare it again.
pb-youtube-research.error.YOUTUBE_RESEAR: Check the source and its exact fields.
pb-youtube-research.error.RIGHTS_REQUIRE: Record current permission to use this client source.
pb-youtube-research.error.YOUTUBE_READ_U: This request was already used. Prepare a new one yourself.
pb-youtube-research.error.QUOTA_REACHED: The local or provider limit was reached. Check your project quota.
pb-youtube-research.error.UPLOAD_LIMIT: Remove an unused source file before adding another.
pb-youtube-research.sourceHelp: Attach the client CSV to this order first. Map its actual headings. Blank measurements stay unavailable.
pb-youtube-research.mappingHelp: Copy each exact column heading from the source file. Do not map two fields to one column.
pb-youtube-research.thresholds: House starting rule: low click-through below 4%, strong retention from 50%, dominant traffic from 50%. These are next-step choices, not forecasts.
pb-youtube-research.archiveQuery: Words to find in your transcripts
pb-youtube-research.archiveBoundary: Speech only, in five-second windows. On-screen text and picture search are planned, waiting for connected local OCR and vision tools. Check those sources manually meanwhile.
pb-youtube-research.consent: I have permission to analyse this exact client export.
pb-youtube-research.receiptUnavailable: The current receipt could not be loaded. Approval is locked.
pb-youtube-research.observed: Observed source sample only. Missing records and private counts are excluded. Review the source and every caveat before sharing.
pb-youtube-research.manualPdf: Automatic PDF printing is unavailable here. Open the saved report and print it yourself.
pb-youtube-research.outlierBoundary: Each video is compared with its own channel median. A channel needs at least four measured videos. This does not predict success.
pb-youtube-research.nicheBoundary: Coverage and medians describe only the returned sample. They do not establish demand or predict earnings.
pb-youtube-research.commentsBoundary: Review each pile yourself. Bait stays held. Replies and pinning are manual, never automatic.
pb-youtube-research.scriptBoundary: Pacing is a model estimate. Only speech counts toward the reading duration; cues stay visible.
pb-youtube-research.directive.more-inten: Make more clips for the measured search intent.
pb-youtube-research.reason.zero-median: The median is zero, so no ratio is reported.
pb-youtube-research.servicesHelp: Choose the exact service you want to sell. The three starter offers stay. You can add up to five offers, then set each price yourself.
pb-youtube-research.addService: Add this service to my plan
pb-youtube-research.serviceAdded: Added without a price. Set your price and accept the updated plan in Your business.
pb-youtube-research.service.weekly-plan: Weekly plan sized to your hours
pb-youtube-research.error.YOUTUBE_SERVIC: This service is already in your plan. Set its price there.
Review the exact YouTube service and its current order intake.
pb-youtube-research.lowCtrBasisPoints: Low click-through threshold, hundredths of a percent
pb-youtube-research.highRetentionBasisPo: High retention threshold, hundredths of a percent
pb-youtube-research.trafficShareBasisPoi: Traffic share threshold, hundredths of a percent
pb-youtube-research.fullScreenUnavailabl: Full screen is unavailable here. You can keep reading in this view.
pb-youtube-research.scriptEnded: Script finished. Restart when you are ready.
pb-youtube-research.caveat.medianViews: Median of returned videos with known views. Missing and unreturned videos are excluded.
pb-youtube-research.caveat.medianAgeDays: Whole UTC calendar days on the observation date, only for returned videos with known publication dates.
pb-youtube-research.caveat.source: Measured source sample only. Missing data stays unavailable; these figures do not predict results.
pb-youtube-research.replyDrafts: Reply drafts, one comment ID: reply per line
pb-youtube-research.openStudio: Open YouTube Studio to post manually
pb-youtube-research.guideProject: Create or choose your own Google Cloud project. Keep its project ID for the local quota counter.
pb-youtube-research.guideEnable: Enable YouTube Data API in that project, then create your own API key in its credentials page.
pb-youtube-research.guideRead: Paste the key here for this session. Review one exact public request before approving its quota use.
pb-youtube-research.guideManual: Private retention and traffic reports still need your YouTube Studio export. Sign-in analytics are planned, pending Google verification and the connector.
pb-youtube-research.guideChecked: Setup guide checked 29 October 2026. Google controls project quota.
